name: Uranium, first four

sprites.name: Raptorch
sprites.note: From behind, the head now tips its snout down and dips as it leans, the same way and by about the same amount as from the front, in both the idle and the alert. Last time the back's head had dropped but still tilted slightly up. The flame still flickers.

sprites.name: Eletux
sprites.note: From behind, the bent foreleg is now the one that pushes forward, and the straight one stays planted, as from the front. They were the other way round. The head change from last time is kept.

note: Third look. Metalynx and Electruxo are in the library. Raptorch and Eletux are redone: the back now makes the same move as the front.
